section.content: The invention aims to provide a machine learning device which can reliably and rapidly improve the image recognition precision. The machine learning device (1) of the present invention includes: an image database (422) that stores a plurality of images and image feature quantities of the plurality of images; and a processor (41) connected to the image database (422) and performing machine learning using the plurality of images and image feature values stored in the image database (422), wherein the processor (41) preferentially selects, as images used for machine learning, a predetermined number of images having a low degree of similarity to images used for machine learning, other than images used for machine learning in the past, from among the images stored in the image database (422), and performs new machine learning using the selected images.
